Question:
Assume the adjoining chart shows the \(1980\) U.S. population, in millions, for each region by ethnic group. To the nearest percent, what percent of the U.S. Black population lived in the South?

\[\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline & \text{NE} & \text{MW} & \text{South} & \text{West}\\ \hline \text{White} & 42 & 52 & 57 & 35\\ \hline \text{Black} & 5 & 5 & 15 & 2\\ \hline \text{Asian} & 1 & 1 & 1 & 3\\ \hline \text{Other} & 1 & 1 & 2 & 4\\ \hline\end{array}\]
